1.web: Working together, we entreat also that you not receive the grace of God in vain,
1.asv: And working together with him we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain

2.web: for he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
2.asv: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee: behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):

3.web: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
3.asv: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;

4.web: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
4.asv: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

5.web: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
5.asv: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

6.web: in pureness, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
6.asv: in pureness, in knowledge, in longsuffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

7.web: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
7.asv: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

8.web: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;
8.asv: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

9.web: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;
9.asv: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

10.web: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
10.asv: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

11.web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
11.asv: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.

12.web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
12.asv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.

13.web: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also be open wide.
13.asv: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto my children), be ye also enlarged.

14.web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
14.asv: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?

15.web: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?
15.asv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?

16.web: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
16.asv: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

17.web: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
17.asv: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,

18.web: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
18.asv: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
